source.creator: FinalClash
source.title: The NEW Void Spell is Actually Broken (Clash Royale)
source.viewed: Actual YouTube player frames in the Codex in-app browser, captured while paused; not a transcript-only inspection.

observations: A compact circular burgundy/dark-red field with a thin bright red/pink rim surrounds an enemy Elixir Collector beside the right enemy Princess Tower.
A narrow pink/red vertical strike lands at the Collector's visible position, and the Collector has a pink hit glow.
The nearby Princess Tower is outside the main visible field and is not receiving that strike.
The Collector is absent, leaving a purple elixir drop animation inside the remaining field.
The dark burgundy field and narrow pink/red rim remain visible after the target disappears.

timing_limit: The game clock moves from approximately 2:28 at player21s to 2:25 at player23s and 2:20 at player26s. The footage is accelerated or edited even though the YouTube player reports playbackRate1. These frames cannot independently establish exact native one-second hit cadence.
target_limit: This cast has one stationary target near the cast center. It supports a target-position strike and persistent field after target death, but cannot independently prove multi-target beams or movement following. The separate BaleGG Aug9 footage supplies those observations and belongs to the older1.2-second cadence balance.

balance_context.current_change: Supercell's Aug26 update changes Void hit frequency from1.2 to1 second, following the Aug4 five-elixir rework. This video was published the next day.
balance_context.claim_limit: Publication date and narration support the post-buff context; the video cannot establish its exact executable client version or a calibrated spell radius.
